why: Hand tally from the evidence alone: Bianchi is absent on an evidenced conflict (e10) and cannot vote remotely (e4), so four of the five members (e1) attend — a quorum (e3) — and the vote proceeds because sponsor Okonkwo wants final action taken (e5, e11, e2). Affirmative votes: Okonkwo (e5) and Tran (e6) — two; Bianchi's support (e9) cannot be cast. Delgado (e7) and Pryce (e8) vote no. The charter requires at least three affirmative votes of the full council (e3); 2 < 3, so the ordinance is not adopted at the session.
